Q00223_TestOfTheChampion/30624-07.html.text: Veteran Ascalon: Go and meet my old comrade, Mason . He is the master of spears and a good and faithful friend. I heard that he settled down somewhere in southern Dion , I wonder how he is doing?

Q00223_TestOfTheChampion/30624-08.html.text: Veteran Ascalon: So you have met Mason and have agreed to seek revenge for him? But... What do you mean revenge..., Revenge on whom?

Q00223_TestOfTheChampion/30624-05.htm.text: Veteran Ascalon: Things are not so different from the time when I was an active soldier. Perhaps a bit more chaotic and violent. The Blue Shark, the Black Lion, the Storm Blade and the Iron Rose which I belonged to... Many soldiers are battling alien armies in many different locations at the moment…

Q00223_TestOfTheChampion/30624-06.htm.text: Veteran Ascalon: Good! First you must go and visit my friend Mason . He is an old comrade of mine.
